description: This file contains C source code implementing functions for interacting with CCSP components via D-Bus, including initialization, shutdown, component discovery, parameter get/set, table entry management, and background commit operations.

methods.name: Cosa_Init
methods.description: Initializes the COSA subsystem with a given bus handle, setting up the destination path based on simulation or real environment.

methods.name: Cosa_Shutdown
methods.description: Performs cleanup and shutdown procedures for the COSA subsystem.

methods.name: Cosa_FindDestComp
methods.description: Discovers the destination component supporting a given object name via D-Bus.

methods.name: Cosa_GetParamValues
methods.description: Retrieves parameter values from a specified component and path.

methods.name: Cosa_SetParamValuesNoCommit
methods.description: Sets parameter values without committing the changes immediately.

methods.name: Cosa_SetCommit
methods.description: Commits or rolls back parameter changes for a component and path.

methods.name: Cosa_GetInstanceNums
methods.description: Retrieves instance numbers for a given object.

methods.name: Cosa_AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to a specified table.

methods.name: Cosa_DelEntry
methods.description: Deletes an entry from a specified table.

methods.name: Cosa_FreeParamValues
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for parameter values.

methods.name: Cosa_BackgroundCommit
methods.description: Performs a background commit or rollback operation asynchronously.
